title: 4 Edges by The Black Lotus [playstation 2]
summary: A recording of The Black Lotus’s 2006 PS2 demo shows snowy landscapes and abstract geometry. The video was uploaded in 2019 and contains strong flashes.

blocks.text: 4 Edges combines camera movement, scene transitions and music into a fixed audiovisual sequence. This capture begins with a snowy landscape and credits, then moves through contrasting architectural and abstract spaces, branching forms and brightly lit geometry. The production was presented at Breakpoint 2006; that event date is distinct from this video’s October 2019 upload. Geir Bjerke identifies the capture equipment as an OSSC and Elgato HD60 Pro.

View the clip as documentation of a particular production and capture chain. It has no gameplay settings to copy into an Android emulator, and the encoded video alone cannot establish the original frame pacing or the cost of each effect. The linked production page and source repository offer a route for deeper investigation. The sequence contains strong flashes and rapid brightness changes; viewers sensitive to flashing imagery may prefer to skip it.
